workflowDetails.title: The Technology Behind Our Bots
workflowDetails.subtitle: Each AiNiBo bot is a self-sufficient system — powered by real-time market data, adaptive logic, and precise engineering. They analyze, react, and trade with an accuracy no human could replicate.

bots.title: Spot Trading Bot
bots.desc:
The Spot Bot is the backbone of the AiNiBo ecosystem — a fully automated trading engine for spot markets such as Binance, Bitget, and KuCoin. It monitors price movements, order book depth, and short-term volatility in real time, combining adaptive trailing logic with dynamic balance management.

When a buy signal is triggered, the bot automatically adjusts the trailing distance based on volatility and market volume. After opening a position, it tracks the peak price and recalculates exit levels to secure profits intelligently. The built-in reset logic allows new trading cycles to start once the market stabilizes.

Everything runs automatically — from API connections and capital allocation to trade logging and analytics. API keys are AES-256 encrypted, and every transaction is recorded and visualized inside the AiNiBo Dashboard.

bots.title: Futures Trading Bot
bots.desc:
Built for traders who value both speed and control. The Futures Bot trades long and short positions using adaptive leverage and AI-based risk management. It analyzes market momentum, funding rates, and liquidation zones in real time, automatically adjusting position size for optimized performance.

Its signal module combines technical indicators such as EMA, RSI, and VWAP with AiNiBo’s proprietary AI sentiment analysis — allowing the bot to detect trend reversals before they appear on the chart.

All key parameters — leverage range, stop-loss logic, maximum open positions, and risk per trade — are configured through the central dashboard. The AI core learns from each session, adapting strategies to your style and continuously improving risk-to-reward efficiency.

bots.title: Arbitrage Bot
bots.desc:
The Arbitrage Bot is built for precision and speed. It simultaneously scans multiple exchanges — including Binance, Bitget, and KuCoin — through WebSocket connections, processing thousands of price updates per second. When a profitable spread appears, it instantly executes dual orders — buying and selling across markets to lock in profit.

The system architecture enables parallel execution with latency below 20 ms. All operations are logged and encrypted in real time, and the bot supports multiple strategies: direct spot arbitrage, triangular trading, and cross-exchange arbitrage. API keys are stored securely and never exposed in plain form.

Developed for professionals, yet intuitive enough for anyone who wants to turn speed and precision into a trading edge.

bots.title: Paper Trading Bot
bots.desc:
The Paper Bot is the perfect training ground. It mirrors real market behavior using live data but operates with virtual capital — allowing you to test strategies safely without risk. Its logic is identical to that of the Spot and Futures Bots: same algorithms, same interface, same experience.

Every simulated trade is recorded — entries, exits, returns, and drawdowns — so you can analyze results and refine your approach. The system also supports replay and backtesting directly within the AiNiBo Dashboard.

Ideal for beginners looking to learn safely, as well as experienced traders fine-tuning their strategies before going live.

services.title: 🌐 AiNiBo Automation & AI Solutions
services.description: At AiNiBo Systems, we don’t just build tools — we build intelligent ecosystems. From websites that react to user behavior to AI assistants that evolve with your business, every solution is designed with one goal: to make automation feel effortless. Each system we develop is stable, secure, and adaptable — powered by proven frameworks, modern design, and deep technical insight.

cards.title: Custom & Platform-Based Website Development
cards.text:
We create websites that go far beyond simple design. Whether it’s a personal portfolio, a company dashboard, or a full-scale digital platform — every project we build is optimized for performance, scalability, and conversion.

Our stack combines **Next.js**, **Tailwind**, and **Supabase** for ultra-fast rendering, modern design consistency, and database flexibility. Stripe and PayPal integrations ensure secure payments, while automation tools connect your forms, CRM, and analytics seamlessly.

Each site is responsive, SEO-optimized, and engineered for long-term reliability — built to look elegant and run like a machine. You focus on your business, we handle the system behind it.

cards.title: SaaS Platform Development
cards.text:
Turn your vision into a subscription-based product that scales. We specialize in building secure, data-driven SaaS platforms — complete with **real-time dashboards**, **automated billing**, and **AI-powered analytics**.

Our systems feature integrated user authentication, cloud hosting, and modular APIs that grow with your user base. From MVP prototypes to enterprise-level platforms, we handle everything — product architecture, UI/UX design, payment integration, and deployment.

Your platform is built for speed, reliability, and independence. You own your data, your users, and your success — we just help you build the foundation.

cards.title: AI Automations & Assistants
cards.text:
Give your business a real brain. Our AI assistants automate customer support, data processing, reporting, and internal communication — freeing your team to focus on strategy and growth.

Each assistant is fine-tuned using **OpenAI**, **LangChain**, and secure access to your own datasets. We train the AI on your documents, tone of voice, and business logic — so it truly speaks your brand’s language.

From chatbots that handle real conversations to backend agents that trigger actions, the goal is simple: less routine, more intelligence. Every automation is transparent, safe, and tailored to how your business actually works.

workflowSteps.title: Our Workflow
workflowSteps.subtitle: Where logic meets creativity — a journey from idea to intelligent automation.

steps.title: Understanding Your Vision
steps.text: We start by listening — not just to what you want built, but why. Through discovery sessions, we analyze your goals, challenges, and user behavior to understand the bigger picture. This becomes the foundation of every technical and creative decision that follows.

steps.title: Designing the Logic
steps.text: Before a single line of code is written, our team maps how your system should think. We build neural-style logic flows, automation paths, and responsive UI designs that make technology feel natural and alive. The result: beauty that works with purpose.

steps.title: Engineering the Core
steps.text: This is where concept becomes code. Using modular frameworks, real-time APIs, and secure cloud architecture, we bring your automation to life. Each component is engineered for performance, scalability, and seamless integration — no shortcuts, no guesswork.

steps.title: Optimization & Evolution
steps.text: Once built, the system begins to learn. We monitor behavior, analyze data, and fine-tune the automation logic for faster reactions and higher accuracy. Every AiNiBo product evolves over time — growing smarter with each interaction.

steps.title: Scaling Your Success
steps.text: After launch, we keep building. From individual automation tools to complete SaaS ecosystems, we scale your digital operations with precision and care. Because for us, growth is not an end — it’s a process that never stops.
